NewsArticle.Title: Web Site Domain Name Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: Web site domain name maintenance occurred about 4 p.m. today. Depending on your geographic location, it may take longer to receive the updated information for the domain name [www.DarkAges.com](http://www.darkages.com/) If you experience difficulty, you can connect to the alternate name: [www1.DarkAges.com](http://www1.darkages.com/) Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
